data: Apple's operating income **rose about 16.4%** from fiscal 2023 to fiscal 2025, based on its annual reports. In fiscal 2023, which ended September 30, 2023, operating income was approximately $114.3 billion ($114,301 million). In fiscal 2025, which ended September 27, 2025, it was approximately $133.1 billion ($133,050 million). That is an increase of about $18.7 billion. For context, fiscal 2024 sat in between at roughly $123.2 billion, so the gain came steadily over both years. These figures are from my own knowledge of the filings rather than a live lookup, so check them against the Form 10-K if you need exact precision.
